red_flags.meaning: “Kupça hazırlanır” (title extract is being prepared) means the property lacks a registered title extract at present, which creates uncertainty regarding future ownership rights.
“hələlik müqavilə ilə satılır” (sold under contract for now) indicates that the transaction relies on a preliminary agreement rather than an official state registry deed, limiting legal security.
“İpotekaya yararsızdır” (unsuitable for mortgage) shows that banks refuse to finance the purchase due to missing state documentation or legal defects.

checklist.step: Verify the status of the title extract preparation and demand written proof from the housing cooperative.
checklist.document: raylıq arayış və ya ilkin müqavilə

checklist.step: Check the builder or housing cooperative reputation and legal permits for the Nərimanov neighbourhood building.
Confirm that the seller holds full rights to transfer the preliminary purchase contract.
Consult an independent lawyer regarding the risks of buying a property without a final state registration.

verdict: This listing carries high legal risks due to the lack of an official title extract and mortgage unavailability in Nərimanov. Buyers should proceed with extreme caution and seek professional legal assistance before making any payments.
